packageRules.description: SHA-pin every GitHub Actions reference — matches this repo's own workflow-security invariant.
Group routine npm minor/patch bumps into one PR. vitepress/vue are excluded here and handled by the rule below.
vitepress ships on an alpha channel (2.0.0-alpha.*) and vue is pinned in step with it — deliberately NOT matched above, so each gets its own ungrouped PR for manual review before merge.

docs/ (Starlight site): astro and @astrojs/starlight are bounded by the ocx theme's peer ranges (starlight >=0.42 <0.43, astro ^7), so they move as one dedicated PR, merged only together with the matching @ocx-sh/theme release.
